name: Senya Ichiya no Koi Monogatari ~Lamp ni Michibikareshi Unmei~
original_name: 千夜一夜の恋物語～ランプに導かれし運命～
source:
You're working as a nurse in a hospital. One day, you came to say goodbye to one of your patients, Fujishima, who's about to leave the hospital. To thank you for all your good work, he offers you a lamp.

Back at home, you rub the lamp to burn incense, but you're sucked in it by force! When you open your eyes... A man you don't even know is facing you. The genie of the lamp tells you that you have to fulfill the real wish each character made if you want to go back to your world!? What does it mean? While you're doing your best to find out how to fulfill their wishes, a new love story begins?

[Edited from Google Play]
translation:
你在医院担任护士。一天，你前去向即将出院的患者藤岛道别。为了感谢你的照料，他送给你一盏灯。

回家后，你擦拭灯身点燃香，却被强行吸进灯里！睁开眼睛时……一个完全不认识的男人正面对着你。灯里的精灵告诉你，想回到原来的世界，就必须实现每个角色真正的愿望！？这是什么意思？在努力找出实现愿望的方法时，一段新的恋爱故事开始了？

[改自Google Play]
